title: 第9章 图书馆与商店街第10章 图书馆
slug: 穿越成了游戏里的炮灰角色
content_zh:
能在开学第一天便成为召唤师的同学总是占少数的，全场也就寥寥几人，樱千代这位来自东流岛的少女便是其中之一，无不彰显着她的天赋与家世。
毕竟掌握魔力的运用，是召唤的基础。
但是魔力的存在除去少数能自我感知的天纵奇才以外，大部分人都需要适当的帮助才能感受到体内的魔力。
法伦也没想到千代会这么直接邀请自己，挠了挠头，有些骑虎难下。
主要是法伦在想，如果自己拒绝了会不会导致千代好感度下降，然后自己的魅力减少，起步阶段当然得保证每一点数值都牢牢地抓在手里。
思索了一会，法伦有些不好意思地说：“谢谢你邀请我，先帮我把位置留着吧。
等我成为召唤师以后再看看我们合不合适。”
“没问题，我等你。”
千代似乎很满意法伦的回答，嘴角露出一抹笑容。
然而，就在这时，系统无情的声音在法伦脑海中响起。
【魅力值-2】
法伦拳头攥紧，额头上青筋暴起。
他刚才可是苦思冥想了许久，才终于想出了这个不算坏的回答，可没想到魅力值居然还是减少了！
他实在想不通问题出在哪里。
法伦目光锐利地扫过周围，心中暗自琢磨着原因。
千代显然对他的回答很满意，所以不可能是她导致魅力值下降。
而一直在吃东西的妮可也没有任何反应，应该与她也无关。
那么，到底是谁让他的魅力值降低呢？
想到这里，法伦的眼神变得不善起来，狠狠地瞪了一圈周围那些被他们的对话吸引过来的同学们。
这些人都是罪魁祸首，一定是这些好事之徒影响了自己的魅力表现。

法伦暗暗发誓，如果再出现这种情况，一定要找个机会好好教训一下这些家伙。
但现在毫无办法的法伦只能狠狠地咬了一口手中的羊角面包。
这时，一个顶着黑眼圈，深灰色短发的女生走了过来，她的眼神锐利，如同捕食者般扫过他们，最终定格在千代身上。
她扬了扬她手中的学生证，表明了她的身份。
“你应该是东流岛的武士或者阴阳师吧？要和我组队吗？我们两个人拿下第一应该没问题吧。”
她的话语中透露出一股不容置疑的自信，但同时也带着一丝挑衅。
周围的同学开始窃窃私语，他们的目光再次被这场突如其来的对话所吸引。
法伦愣了愣，记忆中似乎没有这号人物，这又是哪里冒出来的天才。
青铜门昨天还说我有问鼎前三的资质，该不会他对每个人都这么说吧？
千代并没有立即回应，而是用一种审视的目光打量着这位不速之客，慢慢地说：“想拿第一为什么不去找尤利西斯家的少爷组队呢？”
深灰色头发的女孩想都没想便拒绝了千代的提议：“我跟他相性不符，但是你不一样。
我想我们是一类人。
content_en:
There are always a few students who can become summoners on the first day of school, and there are only a few people in the room. Sakura Chiyo, a girl from Dongliu Island, is one of them, which all shows her talent and family background.
After all, mastering the use of magic power is the basis of summoning.
However, except for a few geniuses who can sense the existence of magic power, most people need appropriate help to feel the magic power in their bodies.
Fallon didn't expect Chiyo to invite him so directly. He scratched his head, feeling a little bit stuck.
The main reason is that Fallon is wondering whether Chiyo's favorability will decrease if he refuses, and his charm will decrease. Of course, he must ensure that every value is firmly grasped in his hands at the beginning.
After thinking for a while, Fallon said sheepishly: "Thank you for inviting me, please save my seat first.
Let's see if we are a good fit after I become a summoner. "
"No problem, I'll wait for you."
Chiyo seemed satisfied with Fallon's answer, a smile appeared on her lips.
However, at this moment, the ruthless voice of the system sounded in Fallon's mind.
[Charm value-2]
Fallon clenched his fists and veins popped out on his forehead.
He had been thinking hard for a long time before he finally came up with this answer that wasn't bad, but he didn't expect that his charm value would actually decrease!
He really couldn't figure out what the problem was.
Fallon glanced sharply around him, secretly wondering why.
Chiyo was obviously satisfied with his answer, so she couldn't be the cause of the decrease in charm.
And Nicole, who had been eating, didn't respond at all, so it probably had nothing to do with her.
So, who made him less attractive?
Thinking of this, Fallon's eyes became evil and he glared at the surrounding students who were attracted by their conversation.
These people are all the culprits. It must be these bad guys who have affected their charm performance.
Fallon secretly vowed that if this happens again, he must find an opportunity to teach these guys a lesson.
But Fallon was now helpless and could only take a hard bite of the croissant in his hand.
At this time, a girl with dark circles under her eyes and short dark gray hair walked over. Her sharp eyes swept across them like a predator, and finally settled on Chiyo.
She waved her student ID card to identify herself.
"You should be a samurai or an onmyoji from Dongliu Island, right? Do you want to team up with me? It should be no problem for the two of us to take first place."
There was an unquestionable confidence in her words, but also a hint of provocation.
The surrounding students began to whisper, and their eyes were once again attracted by this sudden conversation.
Fallon was stunned. There seemed to be no such person in his memory. This was another genius who appeared out of nowhere.
Bronze Gate said yesterday that I have the qualifications to be in the top three. Could it be that he said that to everyone?
Chiyo did not respond immediately, but looked at the uninvited guest with a scrutinizing gaze, and said slowly: "If you want to win first place, why don't you team up with the young master of Ulysses' family?"
The girl with dark gray hair rejected Chiyo's proposal without thinking: "I am not compatible with him, but you are different.
I think we are the same kind of people.
